observations.title: Recover items from a death grave
observations.player_action: Return to the grave and break it, or use the configured sneak-recovery option.
observations.outcome: The grave releases stored possessions and can restore their original inventory slots.
conditions: Owner-only access, sneak recovery, sorting and ghost behavior are configuration options.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Death ID and actual grave recovery are distinct native state transitions; an obituary item alone does not prove recovery. JEM encounter elimination remains authoritative.
